submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on a word inside a verb phrase whose predicate carries elaboration beyond a bare minimal clause, an auxiliary, modal, negation or adverb on the verb, or an additional complement or adjunct such as a prepositional phrase, conjoined noun phrase, predicate nominal or adjective, or measure expression, peaking on the elaborating nominal itself (of, the, to, at, into, 12, chemical, positive) or on the modified verb (called, seek). It stays near-silent on the same nominals in verbless fragments ('A pinch of salt'), in bare light-verb subject-verb-object clauses ('She added salt'), and in unelaborated clauses ('The algorithm runs', 'Our revenue increased yesterday'); the negative pole shows only weak unstructured activity, and the HTML-tag peak is an unrelated leftover offshoot.
